hypotheses.name: MARGINAL_UTILITY_RECURRENCE_CONTROLLER
hypotheses.claim: Continue recurrence only while unresolved causal pressure and expected information/outcome gain justify compute and instability cost; controller inputs may include trend, memory/state capacity, GWT/reentry validity, false-halt risk and hard budget.

hypotheses.name: POLICY_SCOPED_HYPERPOSITION
hypotheses.claim: Preserve unresolved alternatives as first-class semantic state only where explicit future projections can diverge; collapse is allowed only under explicit provenance-bearing arbitration semantics. Physical storage remains backend-neutral.

hypotheses.name: OUTCOME_CREDIT_REENTRY_REWARD_CHAIN
hypotheses.claim: The useful learning path is verified outcome -> causal credit -> admitted reward/state delta -> provenance-bound reentry. Reentry flags or self-generated novelty alone cannot mint material learning.
hypotheses.next_falsifier: truthful/shuffled/delayed/no-reentry factorial plus scalar-vs-typed reward ablation

hypotheses.name: DIRECTED_GWT_CAUSAL_CLOSURE
hypotheses.claim: A WorkspaceEpisode is functionally valid only when selection/broadcast is followed by measurable delivery, reconstruction, use, local effect, verified outcome and valid reentry; stage labels or integration metrics alone are insufficient.
hypotheses.next_falsifier: stage-preserving edge lesions on live trace with blinded validator

hypotheses.name: LANGUAGE_BOUNDARY_PARSER_EQUIVALENCE
hypotheses.claim: ClayCode parser candidates must preserve the selected language across identifier/punctuation/trivia boundaries and strict collision checks; regex-local fixes and green construction are insufficient. V20 has supported boundary counterevidence; V21 is a research-only successor that explicitly conserves maximal qids but must beat selected V17 on exact semantic differentials before selection.
hypotheses.next_falsifier: strict V21 Lark+interegular, frozen G9+Dialect V17-normalized semantics, focused metamorphics, source-span/roundtrip and downstream WP03 replay

hypotheses.name: CROSS_CANONICALIZER_IDENTITY_COUPLING
hypotheses.claim: Production and standalone parser/canonicalizer paths must share a construction contract or prove direct semantic parity under identical corpus/options; independent passes cannot establish identity.

hypotheses.name: IDENTITY_SAFE_PULSE_EFFECTIVIZATION
hypotheses.claim: Content-equivalent A->B->A maintenance may be elided only with an explicit identity-stability witness covering record/version/provenance and downstream segment equivalence. Otherwise every touched logical identity remains invalidated.
hypotheses.next_falsifier: PR150 exact sequential-vs-batched SPM replay, crash/restart and benchmark

hypotheses.name: TYPED_REWARD_MUST_BEAT_SCALAR_CAUSAL_BASELINE
hypotheses.claim: Feature-specific/multihorizon reward is a live successor candidate, not a default. Self/activity novelty is exploration-only until independently verified; typed reward is selected only if it materially improves control over scalar causal outcome value without unacceptable cost/instability.
hypotheses.next_falsifier: historical NAcc baseline vs scalar vs typed vs typed+multihorizon matched factorial

hypotheses.name: COUNTEREVIDENCE_PRESERVING_QUERY_AWARE_RETRIEVAL
hypotheses.claim: Query-aware ClayGraph/EAP traversal is admissible only if counterevidence/refutation/negation recall is explicitly protected and measured; retrieval speed/quality on positive paths alone cannot promote it.
hypotheses.next_falsifier: EAP17 explicit refutation and false-query controls

hypotheses.name: GENERATIVE_PROPOSAL_EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY
hypotheses.claim: Model/Needle/GWT output may propose intent and route, but final effect authorization must be independently decided/enforced by an external capability/gateway boundary with freshness, provenance and replay protection.

hypotheses.name: DUAL_TIME_CAUSAL_FEEDBACK_IDENTITY
hypotheses.claim: Feedback must preserve causal origin episode/time separately from arrival/current application time. A late verified outcome first closes its exact origin episode; only a separately validated consequence may affect current fast state. Old origin epoch does not imply invalid evidence, and explicit rebase/transport is selected only if it beats simpler verified origin-bound feedback.
hypotheses.next_falsifier: H1 asynchronous effects factorial with delay/out-of-order/duplicate/restart/provenance break/semantic expiry comparing origin-verified versus explicit rebase
